comment: MiniDAQ's design and development file (Chapter 16): the design and development clauses of ISO 13485:2016 and the related QMS clauses, with the documents and records that are their evidence. Topics are named in this book's words. tools/design_file.py checks the index, document control and the generated design-file.md (test docs.design_file).
intro: For each clause of ISO 13485:2016 that concerns design and development, the documents and records of MiniDAQ that a reviewer or an auditor opens first. In a real product these are part of the scanner's design and development file, kept in the manufacturer's document management system (assumption: confirm with team where the NeuroLF's file is kept).

clauses.note: Version and history of every controlled document, checked on every change; a changed document gets a new version before the next release.
Generated records are checked against their sources; measurements keep their raw output.
Software part of the ISO 14971 file (Chapter 15).
Requirements from the intended use, the regulations, the risk controls and the performance budget.
Architecture with classified items, data formats, the code and its coding standard.

Decisions with their alternatives (ADRs), and the review at the end of each Part, recorded in the release notes. The review of each change that SDP section 5 asks for is the subject of internal audit finding A-1 (Chapter 16).
Every requirement traced to its tests or its measurement; six presets and static analysis on every change.

clauses.plan: Validation is of the scanner in its use environment: system tests with phantoms (Part IV and Chapters 26 and 27). MiniDAQ alone cannot be validated.

clauses.note: Release process and record (SDP section 8): tagged source, book files and SBOM.

clauses.topic: Control of design and development changes
clauses.note: Change requests with impact analysis and approval (Chapter 16).
Every SOUP item identified by its pin, with its requirements and its known-anomaly review.
In MiniDAQ, problems found by tests, fuzzing, measurements and reviews; at the scanner, complaints and service reports as well.
The audit of Chapter 16, by the author (no independent auditor in a teaching project).
Every problem evaluated for safety; the open ones are stated by each release.
CAPA records with investigation, actions and effectiveness check (Chapter 16).
Preventive actions become rules of the coding standard or checks in CI.
